target.title: fix(voice-call): add timeout to guardedJsonApiRequest
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`guardedJsonApiRequest`, the shared SSRF-guarded JSON client used by the Plivo, Telnyx and Twilio voice-call providers, called `fetchWithSsrFGuard` without a `timeoutMs`. A hanging upstream API could leave the request open indefinitely, matching the class of issues fixed recently in Mattermost (#102027), Nextcloud Talk (#102025) and Google Vertex (#102050).

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a default 30s timeout to every provider API call that goes through this helper, while still allowing individual callers to override it via a new optional `timeoutMs` parameter. This bounds the worst-case wait for provider REST calls without changing the public call sites.

## User Impact

Voice-call provider REST calls now time out instead of hanging forever when an upstream endpoint stops responding.

## Evidence

### Unit tests

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/voice-call/src/providers/shared/guarded-json-api.test.ts extensions/voice-call/src/providers/shared/guarded-json-api.loopback.test.ts
```

Result: 8 passed.

### Real behavior proof

- **Before this change:** `guardedJsonApiRequest` against a loopback server that accepts the connection but never responds would hang indefinitely.
- **After this change:** the same call rejects within the configured timeout.

## Real behavior proof

- **Command run:** `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/voice-call/src/providers/shared/guarded-json-api.loopback.test.ts`
- **Exact output:** `Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 1 passed (1) / Duration ~16s`
- **Head SHA:** `1f9ca7a9c767b33c481cbacb3fdbf2e60d2ad6a4`
- **Environment:** Linux, Node 22.19, local checkout
- **Observed result:** The loopback test rejects before `timeoutMs + 2s` and after `timeoutMs - 100ms` with `timeoutMs: 500`.
- **What was not tested:** Live Plivo/Telnyx/Twilio endpoints (no credentials).
